intent: One compact Sentinel Archive interior connected to the Phase 1 exterior: open exterior threshold, short vestibule, one Archive Computer room, and a durable named Data Core transaction. This configuration does not add AI, combat, damage, hazards, extraction, or mission completion.

interior.purpose: Compact sealed contrast to the open ice basin. The front opening aligns to the exterior Archive threshold; one partition divides the short vestibule from the single objective room.

requires.reason: Cache lapangan memberi credential akses saja; reward final tetap Data Core yang dicatat oleh Archive Computer.

computer.purpose: Satu sumber final teknologi. State aktual: locked, authorized, downloading, collected. Record Data Core dibuat hanya setelah profil lokal berhasil ditulis.
